name: aegis-harness
description: Evidence governance for IDE-driven software engineering.

scripts.aegis:typecheck: if [ -n "$(find src -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ]; then tsc --noEmit; fi
scripts.aegis:verify-structure: npm run aegis:typecheck && npm run aegis:lint && npm run aegis:enforce
scripts.aegis:test: npm run aegis:check-generated-schemas && node scripts/substrates/test/test_semantic_output.mjs && npm run aegis:test:governance-schemas && npm run aegis:test:field-lifecycle && npm run aegis:test:workspace-skeleton && npm run aegis:test:semantic-scout && npm run aegis:test:issue-intake && npm run aegis:test:issue-contract && npm run aegis:test:v7-bilateral
